name: Theme picker
description: Theme previews, or each theme's palette, in Omarchy's carousel without its dim. Typing filters, and Enter runs haseen theme set

placement.description: Where the picker opens: overlay (Omarchy's carousel over the whole screen, with no dim), center (a narrower carousel in a panel in the middle of the screen) or bar (the same in a panel under the bar). In a panel, Escape closes the picker at once, as it closes a menu placed in a panel

debugIpc.description: Test hook: expose IPC target haseen.themepicker to drive the open panel without a keyboard
